publishedHtml:
What Is the Merchant Account

The Merchant Account is a comprehensive tool for managing transactions, receipts, analytics, and documents. Access to the Merchant Account is provided when you connect CloudPayments and/or CloudKassir.

Merchant Account

What You Can Do in the Merchant Account

  • Generate reports

  • Analyze sales and transaction statistics

  • Monitor transactions and process refunds

  • Create payment links, add new websites, and configure payment widgets

  • Stay up to date with the latest CloudPayments news

  • And much more

Getting Started with the Merchant Account

  1. Sign in using the link you receive when you connect CloudPayments and/or CloudKassir.

  2. Add the websites where you plan to accept online payments.

  3. Add team members and assign them roles for collaboration.

How the Merchant Account Helps Your Business

The CloudPayments Merchant Account includes tools that help you identify growth opportunities and improve business performance.

Increase Sales

Advanced Analytics

In the Statistics section, you can segment customers using a wide range of filters, such as city, payment method, or payment system. These insights help you optimize your sales strategy, increase revenue, and improve other key business metrics.

Detailed Error Information

In the Transactions section, you can see which payments were successful and which failed. Failed transactions are highlighted in red and include detailed error descriptions explaining why the payment was declined.

For example, if the customer had insufficient funds or entered incorrect card details, you can share this information with your sales team so they can follow up with the customer and help complete the payment.

Increase Conversion

The more payment options you offer, the higher your conversion rate.

In the Websites section, you can enable additional payment methods to reduce cart abandonment and incomplete orders while increasing impulse purchases.

Reduce Your Team's Workload

You can add your team members to the CloudPayments Merchant Account and manage their access to different sections.

This helps automate workflows, improve collaboration, and speed up information sharing.

Roles and User Management

Learn how to secure your Merchant Account with two-factor authentication (2FA), add users, assign roles, and manage team permissions in the CloudPayments Merchant Account.

Why Roles Matter

Roles allow you to control access for different team members and tailor the Merchant Account to their responsibilities.

For example:

  • Accountants can access reports and receipts.

  • Managers can view transactions and analytics.

  • Technical specialists can manage websites and integrations.

Using roles allows you to:

  • Restrict access to financial and technical information

  • Separate responsibilities across your team

  • Reduce the risk of errors when working in the Merchant Account

The table below shows which sections of the Merchant Account are available to users based on their assigned role. This helps you determine the appropriate level of access for each team member when using CloudPayments.

Role-Based Access

Two-Factor Authentication (2FA): What It Is and Why You Need It

Two-factor authentication (2FA) provides an additional layer of security for your account. After entering your password, you'll be asked to verify your identity using a one-time code sent via SMS.

Today, a username and password alone are no longer enough to keep your account secure. This is especially important when your account provides access to payment management and customer data. That's why we've added a second layer of protection to help keep your information safe.

If you and your colleagues use the same Merchant Account, we recommend creating a separate user account for each team member. It's quick and only takes a minute.

Otherwise, only the person whose phone number is linked to the account will be able to sign in.

How to Grant Access and Add a User in the Merchant Account

Merchant Account → Users → Add User

  1. Enter the user's full name.

  2. Select a role.

  3. Configure website access.

  4. Enter the user's email address (required). An invitation email with a sign-in link will be sent to this address.

For detailed instructions, see the User Account Creation Guide

Mobile App

CloudPayments Is Now on Your Phone

We've launched the CloudPayments mobile app for iOS and Android. Stay connected to your business and manage key operations from anywhere—even when you're away from your computer.

With the app, you can:

  • Monitor payments, refunds, and orders

  • View transaction details

  • Receive important notifications

  • Contact support quickly

Everything you need to manage your business—right at your fingertips.
